title: An imprint method to produce surface asperities for EHL and RCF experiments
author: Everitt, Alfredsson, et al.

steps.title: Manufacture blank discs
steps.instruction: Produce three blank disc blanks that will become the indent‑disc, the asperity‑disc, and the counter‑disc.

steps.title: Harden indent disc
steps.instruction: Heat‑treat the blank designated as the indent‑disc to achieve the required hardness for subsequent imprinting.

steps.title: Create Rockwell cone indents
steps.instruction: Using a Rockwell cone indenter, generate the desired indents on the hardened indent‑disc.

steps.title: Remove pile‑up around indents
steps.instruction: Machining or polishing steps are applied to eliminate the pile‑up material that forms around each indent on the indent‑disc.

steps.title: Imprint asperities via rolling
steps.instruction: Roll the soft blank disc (to become the asperity‑disc) against the hardened indent‑disc so that the indent pattern is transferred as integrated asperities of 4–15 µm height and 100–200 µm diameter.

steps.title: Harden asperity and counter discs
steps.instruction: Heat‑treat both the newly imprinted asperity‑disc and the separate counter‑disc to the required hardness for the EHL and RCF tests.

steps.title: Conduct EHL experiments
steps.instruction: Assemble the hardened asperity‑disc and counter‑disc in the elastohydrodynamic lubrication test rig and run the EHL experiments.
